answer: An agent buying umber tiles and opal ornaments for a garden uses a posted-price procurement rule: it fixes the unit price and total quantity before receiving offers, with no per-seller bonus. Payment covers only inspected goods delivered against the remaining order quantity. Fake seller accounts cannot raise the price through sham competing bids or multiply the order budget; they must supply real goods to get paid. This resists sybil price manipulation, though it does not guarantee fair allocation among sellers.
